## Executive Summary
EN: AI Skills Full Corpus (GLOBAL) top 3: find-skills / deepseek-r1-reasoning-distiller / vercel-react-best-practices. Peak lift: skill-telemetry-probe (28.0%/1k tok). Fork alert: frontend-design-mega-bundle flags bloat; myrilum-geo-citation-auditor is a high-lift sleeper.
ZH: AI Skills 全量语料（GLOBAL）前三：find-skills / deepseek-r1-reasoning-distiller / vercel-react-best-practices；最高单位增益 skill-telemetry-probe（28.0%/1k tok）。分叉预警：frontend-design-mega-bundle 属上下文膨胀，myrilum-geo-citation-auditor 属高增益黑马。

## Evaluation Methodology
- Confidence Decay: 90-day half-life exponential decay anchored to snapshot verification timestamps.
- Token Efficiency (liftPer1kTokens): (netCapabilityLiftPct / contextTokenCost) * 1000.
- Manifold Score: Riemannian weighted combination of token efficiency, log adoption, 24h/8w velocity, regional model affinity, and 3-engine static hygiene.
- Paraconsistent Forks: CONVERGENT_LEADER, PRODUCTION_WORKHORSE, CONTEXT_BLOAT_WARNING, HIGH_LIFT_SLEEPER.
